data.one_liner: Android implementation of the video_player plugin
data.what_it_does: Provides the Android-specific platform implementation for the video_player plugin using ExoPlayer. It handles video playback, track selection, and buffer control on Android devices.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app that plays videos on Android using the standard video_player plugin
You need to interact directly with the Android video player implementation APIs
avoid_when: You are using a completely different video playback engine like media_kit or just_audio
You want a cross-platform approach without needing endorsed federated packages
strengths: Automatically included as an endorsed package when using video_player
Leverages ExoPlayer for robust video playback on Android
weaknesses: Platform views on Android have known issues when using VideoViewType.platformView
data.setup_notes: Endorsed package; automatically included when using video_player. Only add to pubspec.yaml if importing and using APIs directly.

alternatives.name: media_kit
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative general-purpose media player for Flutter based on libmpv.
